answers.core: it is part of the editor, I do not know to what degree a third party extension can affect this
answers.workaround: It would be used often by me, and I have no idea how this could be worked around with script. It is ofcourse trivial to manually switch to remote after running the game, but this would be a great quality-of-life change for me atleast. This _is_ somewhat mitigated by the hot-reload behavior of the editor, but that does not always work, so I find myself having to re-play the game quite often

title: Automatically switch Scene Tree view to Remote when playing the project/scene from the editor
